_readme: OXID eShop pack knowledge. Structural conventions (metadata.php, source/modules, vendor/oxid-esales, the class chain) are STABLE and live in pack.json as_source.

The two lists below are SEED, not verified facts: they were assembled from general OXID knowledge and must be re-verified per engagement against docs.oxid-esales.com and the CHANGELOG of the graphql-base / graphql-storefront module versions actually in scope.

target_api_endpoint_families lists GraphQL operations from the OPTIONAL graphql-base + graphql-storefront modules - the core metapackage ships no storefront REST or GraphQL API. Treat every entry as 'check whether this operation exists in the module release in scope', never as a coverage promise.

target_content_component_types mixes core oxcontent CMS records, theme-level Twig block regions and Visual CMS module widgets - these are three different mechanisms with different licences and different editability, see pack.json as_target.snippets.content_model_notes.
target_api_endpoint_families: graphql mutation: token (login) and tokenCustomerDelete / refresh - graphql-base authentication
graphql query: product / products (filter, sort, pagination)
graphql query: category / categories (tree, seo slug)
graphql query: manufacturer / manufacturers
graphql query: vendor / vendors
graphql query: attribute / attributes and selectionList (variant selection)
graphql query: basket / baskets and mutations basketCreate, basketAddItem, basketRemoveItem, basketAddVoucher
graphql mutation: placeOrder (checkout completion - verify existence and scope per module release)
graphql query: order / orders (customer order history)
graphql query: customer and mutations customerRegister, customerEmailUpdate, customerPasswordChange, customerInvoiceAddressSet, customerDeliveryAddressAdd
graphql query: review / reviews and mutations reviewSet, reviewDelete
graphql query: content / contents (oxcontent CMS records returned as HTML strings)
graphql query: link / links
graphql query: country / countries, currency, language
graphql query: deliveryMethod / deliveryMethods and paymentMethod / paymentMethods (verify checkout-relevant coverage)
graphql query: wishedPrice / wishedPrices and mutation wishedPriceSet
graphql query: banner / banners and promotion / promotions
graphql query: newsletterStatus and mutations newsletterOptIn / newsletterUnsubscribe
graphql query: seoUrl / seo slug resolution
graphql query: wishlist and noticeList (basket-type lists)
graphql query: basket costs (delivery, payment, voucher, VAT breakdown - verify field names)
REST: no first-party storefront REST API in the metapackage - REST endpoints in a project are partner or custom modules (verify what exists before scoping)
REST/admin: no documented public admin REST API - back-office automation goes through CLI commands, direct DB or a custom module (verify)
target_content_component_types: CMS page (oxcontent, type page - editable rich text with per-language columns)
CMS snippet / include (oxcontent referenced by ident from a template or email)
Category description and category long description
Product short and long description (rich text on the product)
Manufacturer / vendor description page
Promotion or action banner (oxactions record with banner presentation)
Newsletter template (oxnewsletter, plain and HTML body)
Transactional email template (theme or module Twig template plus CMS snippet)
Theme template block region (metadata.php blocks target - developer artefact, not business-editable)
Widget controller output (e.g. product list, cross-selling, review widget embedded into a template)
SEO metadata and URL slug entry (title, description, seo url per object and language)
Visual CMS content block / row-and-column grid (module, licensed - verify edition)
Visual CMS text / HTML widget
Visual CMS image widget
Visual CMS product and product-list widget
Visual CMS slider / banner widget
Visual CMS video widget
Visual CMS accordion / tab widget
Landing page (CMS page plus a dedicated theme template)
Legal / info page (CMS page used for imprint, terms, privacy - DACH compliance content)

_stamp.source: seed from general platform knowledge, to be verified
